Aalia made a profit this Diwali. So why is her bank empty? Let's find out.
Aalia runs a sweet shop. This Diwali was her best ever. Six laakh in sales.
Her books showed a profit of one laakh twenty thousand. She was thrilled.
Then, on the first of November, she checked her bank. Ten thousand rupees.
And this week, she owed two laakh ten thousand in bills.
So, where did the cash go?
Three laakh was stuck with customers who said, we'll pay after Diwali.
And one and a half laakh was sitting on her shelf, as extra stock.
Profit is what you earn on paper. Cash is what you can spend today.
Now meet a second Aalia. Same sales. Three cash habits.
Fifty percent advance on bulk orders. A due date on every credit. And stock bought in smaller batches.
Every Monday, a four week cash calendar. AI builds it from her bank statement in minutes.
Her bills get paid on time. No panic loan.
Profit is an opinion. Cash is a fact.
